verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's overview docs say AI Gateway lets users define request retries in case of an error, so the product itself claims the capability. The pack documents no retry-policy configuration, such as attempt counts, backoff, or which transient error codes trigger a retry. The well-documented fallback feature (switching providers on errors or timeouts) is a different capability and does not count as retry policy. Missing for 10: documented retry configuration parameters (max attempts, backoff/delay), selection of retryable error classes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that retries work.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Improve resilience by defining request retry and model fallbacks in case of an error.
